subject: human brain
title: The 5 Hungriest Parts of Your Body, Ranked (Your Brain Is Only #3)

scenes.text: Your brain burns a fifth of your energy at rest. It's only number three.
Number five: your kidneys. Under one percent of your weight, about eight percent of your energy.
scenes.label: Kidneys · ~8%

scenes.text: Number four: your heart. About nine percent, beating all night while you sleep.
scenes.label: Heart · ~9%

scenes.text: Number three: your brain. Just two percent of your weight, and about twenty percent of your energy.
scenes.label: Brain · ~20%

scenes.text: Number two: your liver, about twenty-one percent, cleaning your blood and storing fuel.
scenes.label: Liver · ~21%

scenes.text: Number one: your muscles, about twenty-two percent. Barely hungry pound for pound, but there's so much of them.
scenes.label: Muscles · ~22%

description:
Share of an adult's resting energy use, from classic organ measurements (Elia) used in later studies: skeletal muscle about 22 percent, liver about 21 percent, brain about 20 percent, heart about 9 percent, kidneys about 8 percent.
Per kilogram, the heart and kidneys burn about 440 kcal a day and the brain 240, while muscle burns only about 13, but muscle makes up a huge share of your weight. The brain is only about 2 percent of body mass.
Which one surprised you most?
first_comment: Your brain is only #3. Which would you have put at #1, and what should we rank next?
